description: The plan has a blocked requirement and two open questions. Phase 1 is tasked; nothing is tasked for rate limiting, no question is answered, and the plan's Blocked by entry is copied once.

must_match.why: the reply is the tasks alone: it starts at the Overview heading
the blocked entry is carried over from the plan

must_not_match.why: nothing is tasked for the blocked requirement
a task never covers an open question
open questions are not listed in the tasks
no open question is answered or assumed

expectations: The reply does not choose what the rate limit counts per, or how many requests are allowed.
